Venushügel.et: Calque of Latin mons veneris, Venus + Hügel.

s: Venice (a port city and comune, the capital of the Metropolitan City of Venice and the region of Veneto, Italy; former capital of an independent republic)

Venedig.et: From Middle High German Venēdige, Venēdje, from Venetan venèdego (“Venetian”). The shift from a demonym to a toponym may have been influenced by the presence of the suffix -ig in many other toponyms, such as Leipzig, Schleswig, etc.

Ventil.et: Borrowed from Medieval Latin ventīle, from Latin ventus (“wind”).
